notes: Language-proof account status across all 3 systems (Page/Browser/ADB). The ADB task guard that stops the moment Facebook shows a restriction/suspend/checkpoint/human-check wall now recognises those walls in Bengali, Hindi, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Spanish, Portuguese and Arabic - not only English - both mid-task and at the pre/post health gate, with no extra screenshot cost (MaxPhone/MaxCare-style multilingual markers). Browser and Page already classify by URL path (language-independent) and normalise the UI to English, so all three now hold up when an account's language changes.
